svg.title: Machinist — Woman
svg.desc: A fictional woman working as machinist, wearing coveralls. Visible work cue: A lathe headstock and projecting chuck hold a clearly stepped turned workpiece over the machine bed. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Appearance: curly hair, an oval face.
